Bees appear in flight, on flowers, near hives, and in decorative insect compositions.
Songbirds, water birds, birds of prey, and other feathered species appear alone or in natural settings.
Butterflies appear with varied wing patterns, flowers, garden settings, and close symmetrical views.
Cats and kittens appear in resting, playful, portrait, household, and decorative scenes.
Dogs appear with Santa hats, gifts, decorated trees, winter clothing, and other Christmas details.
Cows appear in pasture views, farm scenes, portraits, and friendly stylized poses.
Deer appear as woodland animals, antlered portraits, family groups, and quiet forest scenes.
Dolphins leap, swim in groups, surface near waves, and appear in underwater scenes.
Ducks and ducklings appear swimming, standing, nesting, and moving through pond settings.
Eagles appear in flight, perched with spread wings, in close portraits, and over landscapes.

Foxes appear standing, curled, running, in family groups, and within woodland scenes.

Bees, beetles, butterflies, spiders, and other small creatures appear in close views and nature settings.
